function.name: web_research
function.description: Perform deep web research on a specific topic. Searches DuckDuckGo, visits the top search results, and parses the webpage contents into Markdown for learning new APIs or solving unknown errors.

query.description: The search query (e.g. 'playwright python documentation', 'pytest fixtures')

max_results.description: Maximum number of webpages to fetch and analyze (default: 3)
